meta.title: PCB — From Conversation to Product, From Ideas to Value
meta.desc: PCB is a local AI workspace built and extended around Oh My Pi. Turn ideas into software through natural language, planning and local execution, then move into VS Code or Cursor with OMP-ckpt when you need deeper control. Open source, MIT.
hero.title: From Conversation to Product.
hero.lead: PCB is a local AI workspace built and extended around Oh My Pi.
hero.lead2: Turn ideas into software through natural language interaction, intelligent planning and local execution. Start with a simple conversation, develop your project with AI, and move into VS Code or Cursor whenever you need deeper control.
hero.flow.label: Five product stages
hero.alt: The PCB three-pane interface: projects and conversation on the left, the plan in the middle, files and execution results on the right
hero.visual.caption: The PCB workspace: project, conversation, plan and file changes in one place
work.title: From an Idea to a Product.
work.lead: PCB brings natural language interaction, AI task planning and local execution together in one workspace.
work.lead2: PCB does not implement a second AI agent. OMP does the actual AI work; PCB makes that process more direct and easier to control.
work.chat.sub: Tell the AI what you want to build.
work.chat.d: State requirements, discuss the product idea, analyse problems, read code and explore solutions in plain language. An ordinary conversation does not modify project files.
work.plan.sub: Let the AI understand the project and shape an approach.
work.plan.d: OMP can read project context, analyse the request and turn it into a concrete task plan. You inspect the plan before deciding whether to approve it.
work.build.sub: Turn the idea into code and a real product.
work.build.d: Once the plan is approved, OMP runs the tasks on this machine, edits files and calls the tools it needs. You keep the authorisation and review points while it runs.
work.review.sub: Check the changes and confirm the result.
work.review.d: Look at the actual file changes, then accept them or restore the previous state.
work.note: Review is the checking step inside the Build workflow. It is not a separate AI engine standing beside Chat, Plan and Build.
ide.title: A Better Way to Build with AI.
ide.lead: For deeper development, PCB opens the desktop VS Code or Cursor already installed on your machine.
ide.lead2: In the editor you already know, OMP and OMP-ckpt cover writing code, AI edits, diff review and project recovery.
ckpt.title: Keep AI Development Visible, Traceable and Recoverable.
ckpt.lead: AI can change a lot of code quickly, but a developer needs to know what happened to the project and to keep the ability to recover when a change is not what was intended. OMP-ckpt provides checkpoint management for OMP-assisted development.
ckpt.1.d: Save project state at key points during development, so there is something to return to later.
ckpt.2.d: Keep checkpoints from different stages so continuous AI edits stay manageable.
ckpt.3.d: When an AI edit causes trouble, restore project state from an earlier checkpoint.
ckpt.4.d: A Git repository is not a prerequisite: the checkpoint mechanism also works on projects that were never put under Git.
ckpt.5.d: Works alongside desktop editors such as VS Code and Cursor, so you review AI edits in the environment you already use.
ckpt.note: OMP-ckpt is a project state protection and recovery tool. It is not a replacement for Git, and it is not another AI agent. Implementation details, restore granularity and file exclusion rules follow the current source.
who.title: One Workspace. Different Ways to Work.
who.lead: PCB ships as one package. If you don't work in code, collaborate with the AI in plain language. If you do, open the VS Code or Cursor already on your machine to inspect, edit and go further.
who.note: One package only. The IDE is an optional external environment: PCB does not bundle an editor and does not install one for you.
path.title: From Ideas to Products. From Products to Market.
path.lead: PCB is not only about building the software. The goal is to connect product demonstration, distribution and commercialisation into one path.
journey.chat.d: Raise an idea in plain language, discuss requirements, explore what is possible.
journey.plan.d: Let the AI understand the requirement, analyse the project and write the implementation plan.
journey.build.d: Build and implement the product with OMP, your IDE and OMP-ckpt.
journey.promote.d: A product demo skill helps organise the build story, produce feature demos and intro videos, and progressively connect social and product promotion channels.
journey.monetize.d: Payment features and related service interfaces for software sales, digital product delivery and commercialising AI products.
path.note: The first three stages are available today. Promote and Monetize are planned and not yet provided.
road.title: The Road Ahead.
road.lead: PCB will grow from a local AI development workspace into a tool platform that covers product demonstration, promotion and commercialisation.
road.demo.d: Turn the experience of building real products with PCB and OMP into a dedicated skill. Using real development cases, the AI can help organise the product idea, the build process, the feature story and the demo video.
road.demo.goal: Make it easier for every user to show the product they created.
road.social.d: Connect product introductions and demo videos to external channels, so users can prepare their material and progressively publish to supported social and product promotion platforms.
road.social.goal: Let the products people build be discovered.
road.pay.d: Introduce payment, purchase flows and related service interfaces step by step, as infrastructure for software sales, digital product delivery and AI product commercialisation.
road.pay.goal: Let a product not only exist, but create commercial value.
road.note: All three items are Coming Next. None of them is available today.
sec.title: Your Projects. Your Machine. Your Control.
sec.lead: PCB keeps the AI workspace on the user's own computer. PCB handles interaction and safety controls; OMP does the AI work.
sec.engine.d: OMP runs as a subprocess on this machine and handles conversation, planning and file operations.
sec.local.d: The PCB service listens only on 127.0.0.1 and does not expose the local workspace to the public network.
sec.auth.d: A plan runs only with your explicit approval; protected commands require additional confirmation.
sec.file.d: The OMP-ckpt checkpoint mechanism gives project changes a way back.
sec.ide.d: Use the VS Code or Cursor already installed on your machine. PCB bundles no editor and installs none.
sec.note: Whether a request sends context to a model provider depends on the model and configuration you use.

faq.title: What you need to know about PCB.
faq.lead: What it is, how OMP fits, and which capabilities exist today.
faq.a1: PCB is a local AI workspace built and extended around Oh My Pi. It helps people get work done through natural language, task planning and local execution, and expands step by step toward product creation, promotion and commercialisation.
faq.q2: How does PCB relate to Oh My Pi?
faq.a2: OMP is the AI execution engine: it handles conversation, planning and file edits. PCB provides the interface, the workflow and the safety controls. PCB does not re-implement an agent.
faq.a3: OMP-ckpt provides checkpoint management and project state recovery for AI-assisted development, so developers can see and manage the changes continuous AI edits make to a project.
faq.q4: Do I need VS Code or Cursor?
faq.a4: No. PCB works on its own. When you need deeper development, you can open the VS Code or Cursor already installed on your machine.
faq.q5: Will the AI change my files by itself?
faq.a5: Ordinary conversation does not modify the project. Entering Build requires approving a plan, and commands that need confirmation ask again.
faq.q6: What if a change goes wrong?
faq.a6: You can restore an earlier project state from an OMP-ckpt checkpoint. For important projects, also keep using Git or another version control system.
faq.q7: Does this website upload my project?
faq.a7: The PCB website does not store or run your project. Project operations happen locally. When an AI task runs, the context sent to the model service may reach that provider, depending on the model and configuration you use.
faq.q8: Can I use demo, promotion or payment today?
faq.a8: Those are planned. The product demo skill, social publishing and payment interfaces are not available yet.
bugs.title: Report a problem
bugs.lead: Open an issue on GitHub: say which build, which system, what you did and what you saw. Please do not paste API keys or source code.
about.title: PCB — From Ideas to Value.
about.p1: PCB is an open-source, local-first AI product creation platform.
about.p2: From conversations and planning to software development, and later product demonstration, promotion and monetization, PCB aims to help more people turn ideas into real products with AI.
